title: Peaceful Coexistence
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use role plays and class agreements. Link to Grade 6 methods (dialogue, negotiation, mediation, arbitration).

skills.key_step: The child names the qualities of a peaceful person.

floor.question: Give one way of promoting peace.
floor.answer: any way such as a peace club

steps: Say what a non-peaceful person would do.

board.do: Write: "Otieno was insulted and calmly said how he felt."

misconceptions.ask: Why does a peaceful person walk away from a fight?
misconceptions.repair: Ask whether it takes courage to forgive.

misconceptions.ask: Someone insulted Otieno. What does a peaceful person do?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what happens after both people insult each other.

misconceptions.ask: Can a peaceful person disagree with others?
Does forgiving someone mean what they did was right?
misconceptions.repair: Discuss forgiving while still asking the person to change.

checks.question: Give two qualities of a peaceful person.
checks.answer: any two of: tolerance, forgiveness, respect, honesty, fairness, patience, kindness, listening

skills.key_step: The child chooses factors that promote peaceful coexistence.

floor.prerequisite: Names qualities of a peaceful person.
floor.question: Give one quality of a peaceful person.

representations: a peace map of a community
steps: Say what peace lets people do.

board.do: Write: "All the water is given to one village."

listen_for: Giving all the resources to one group
misconceptions.ask: Which promotes peace in a community?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what happens when one village is given all the water.

misconceptions.ask: Which makes a community more peaceful?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what dialogue between two clans can solve that a gun cannot.

misconceptions.ask: How do elders promote peace in a community?
misconceptions.repair: Recall elders mediating in a Grade 5 story.

misconceptions.ask: Why does respect between faiths help peace?

checks.question: Give two factors that promote peaceful coexistence.
checks.answer: any two of: respect for the law, justice, fair sharing, dialogue, tolerance, good leaders, peace committees, elders

checks.question: Why does peace matter to a community?
checks.answer: people can farm, trade, study and be safe

skills.key_step: The child orders the steps of peaceful conflict resolution and picks the right method.

floor.prerequisite: Describes peaceful methods of resolving conflict.
floor.question: What is mediation?
floor.answer: a third person helping two sides agree

steps: Listen to each side and name the problem.
contexts: two learners and a broken ruler
a mediator at a market quarrel

board.do: Write the steps in mixed order.

listen_for: Takes the side of one person
misconceptions.repair: Ask why a referee in football should not support one team.

misconceptions.ask: What is the first step in solving a conflict peacefully?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what would happen if the teacher decided without hearing both learners.

misconceptions.ask: When does reconciliation come in solving a conflict?
Is fighting a method of resolving conflict?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what happens after the fight.

checks.question: What is the first step in solving a conflict peacefully?
checks.answer: stay calm and listen to each side
